mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS dept_id, d.dept_name AS dept_name, d.dept_code AS dept_code, ud.is_primary AS is_primary, ud.status AS status, ud.position AS position, ud.join_time AS join_time FROM user_dept ud INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON ud.dept_id = d.id AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.status = 0 WHERE ud.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ud.is_primary DESC, ud.join_time DESC

SELECT up.id AS id, up.post_id AS post_id, sp.post_name AS post_name, sp.post_code AS post_code, up.is_primary AS is_primary, up.status AS status FROM user_post up INNER JOIN sys_post sp ON up.post_id = sp.id AND sp.status = 0 WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY up.is_primary DESC, up.assignment_date DESC
